email.subject: Your site's photos may be costing you patients
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I looked at Gentle Dentistry's site. Your three photos are 9-12MB each unresized, which makes the page slow to load, especially on phones. Most people searching for a dentist nearby will bounce before it finishes loading, often straight to a competitor's listing.

I also didn't see any patient reviews on the page. For a dental practice, that's usually the first thing new patients look for before booking.

I fix issues like these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what's slowing your site down and what I'd do about it?

Alex
Northlight Web
